rows.note: This is the all-purpose verb for reminding someone or bringing something to their attention.

example.english: Thanks—you remind me that I have to hand in my homework tomorrow.
example.traditional: 多謝你提醒我聽日要交功課。
example.jyutping: do1 ze6 nei5 tai4 sing2 ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 gaau1 gung1 fo3

rows.note: Use this when something causes A to think of or remember B, rather than simply prompting A to notice it.

example.english: This song helps remind me of when I was little.
example.traditional: 呢首歌令我諗起細個嗰陣。
example.jyutping: ni1 sau2 go1 ling6 ngo5 lam2 hei2 sai3 go3 go2 zan6
